text: [177] 87 catūhāvuso dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no #1 ma. atthūpaparikkhitā . evamuparipi . paresaṃ . katamehi catūhi . idhāvuso bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu sutānañca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthūpaparikkhī hoti atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti no ca kalyāṇavāco hoti .pe. no ca sandassako hoti .pe. sabrahmacārīnaṃ . imehi kho āvuso catūhi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano no paresaṃ .
